The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Local Government Notifications
1A- PG 7136 - 06 (06/2025) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
NOTIFICATION MADE UNDER SECTION 66(C) OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE, CHAPTER 262, AS AMENDED BY THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTES ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 22 OF 2012

BY virtue of powers vested in me under Section 66(c) of the Local Government Institutes Elections Ordinance, Chapter 262, As amended by Local Government Institutes Election (Amendment) Act, No.22 of 2012, I, Herath Mudiyanselage Sanjeewani Herath the Commissioner of Local Government in the North Western Province, hereby notify that the first meeting will be convened for the purpose of electing Mayor/ Chairman, Deputy Mayor/ Vice Chairman for the Local Government Institutions set out in the following Schedule at the respective venue, time and date correspondingly specified in the following schedule itself. H.M. Sanjeewani Herath, Commissioner of Local Government, North Western Province.
Department of Local Government, 2nd Floor, Vidusara, Provincial Council Office Complex,Kurunegala.02nd of June 2025.
